content.text:
I fixed the bug so the version dropdown now shows the version you're actually viewing, even when the `current` version's path is set to `/`. The existing client tests pass (44/44), but I didn't add a test for this exact setup or check the fix in a running site.

**Cause:** In `packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/docsClientUtils.ts`, `getActiveVersion` works out which version a page belongs to by comparing the URL against each version's path. It always checked the "last" (latest released) version last, assuming that was the version sitting at the root `/docs`. In your config, `current` sits at the root instead, so it was checked before the others. Its path matches every docs page, so it won every time — `/docs/v0.1.2/...` was reported as `current`.

**Fix:** Versions are now checked from the longest path to the shortest. A version path that contains another is always longer, so the most specific one (e.g. `/docs/v0.1.2`) is tried first. The root version (`/docs`) is only matched when nothing else fits, whichever version is mounted there.

`package.json` already had a change before I started (a `packageManager` field was added). I didn't touch it.
